aries.title: A day to start something
aries.body: Energy runs quick and direct. Good for first steps, honest answers and a little courage. Watch for impatience.

taurus.title: Slow down and savour
taurus.body: Comfort, steadiness and simple pleasures feel right. A good day for patience and caring for your body.

gemini.title: Curious and talkative
gemini.body: Conversations, messages and new ideas flow easily. Keep it light, and listen as much as you speak.

cancer.title: Close to home and heart
cancer.body: Feelings run nearer the surface. Time with people who feel safe, and a little self-care, go a long way.

leo.title: Let your warmth show
leo.body: A day for generosity, play and being seen. Share appreciation freely, and enjoy receiving it.

virgo.title: Small things, done well
virgo.body: Order and usefulness feel satisfying. Tidy one corner of life, and go gently with yourself and others.

libra.title: Seek balance together
libra.body: Harmony, fairness and beauty matter more today. A good time for kind words and meeting halfway.

scorpio.title: Go deeper
scorpio.body: Feelings are intense and honest. A day for real talk, trust and letting go of what no longer fits.

sagittarius.title: Open horizons today
sagittarius.body: Curiosity and optimism come easily. Learn something, plan an adventure, and say what you mean, kindly.

capricorn.title: Steady and purposeful
capricorn.body: Structure and commitment feel grounding. Take one practical step towards something that matters to you.

aquarius.title: Think freely
aquarius.body: Fresh ideas and friendship are favoured. Give others room to be themselves, and yourself too.

pisces.title: Soft and intuitive
pisces.body: Imagination, empathy and dreams are close. Rest, create, and protect your energy where you need to.

numbersReading.title: Your numbers
numbersReading.intro: Numbers from your birth date and today's date.
numbersReading.howLifePath: Life path: month, day and year each reduced to one digit ({parts}), then added ({total}). 11, 22 and 33 are kept as master numbers.
numbersReading.howCycle: Your year adds your birth month and day to this year; your month adds this month; your day adds today's date. Each is reduced to one digit.
numbersReading.needsBirth: Add your birth date to see your numbers.
numbersReading.note: Numerology is a tradition for reflection, not a prediction.

d1.title: A day to begin
d1.body: Fresh starts come easily. Take the first step on something you have been putting off, and trust your own lead.

d2.title: A day for together
d2.body: Patience and cooperation work better than pushing. Listen closely, and let small kindnesses do the work.

d3.title: A day to express
d3.body: Words, play and creativity flow. Share an idea, reach out to a friend, and let yourself enjoy the day.

d4.title: A day to build
d4.body: Steady effort pays off. Sort, plan and finish one practical thing; solid ground makes everything else easier.

d5.title: A day for change
d5.body: Expect the unexpected and stay flexible. Try something new, move your body, and leave room for surprise.

d6.title: A day for care
d6.body: Home, family and close relationships ask for attention. Offer support, and accept it when it is offered to you.

d7.title: A day to reflect
d7.body: Quiet helps you see clearly. Make time to think, read or rest before you decide anything big.

d8.title: A day for strength
d8.body: Focus and confidence are on your side. Handle practical matters, money or decisions with a calm, firm hand.

d9.title: A day to let go
d9.body: Something is ready to close. Finish, forgive or clear space, so there is room for what comes next.

n1.title: The initiator
n1.body: Independent and driven, you are here to lead and to start things others only imagine.

n2.title: The peacemaker
n2.body: Sensitive and diplomatic, you bring people together and notice what others miss.

n3.title: The communicator
n3.body: Expressive and warm, you inspire through words, humour and creativity.

n4.title: The builder
n4.body: Reliable and practical, you create lasting foundations through patience and care.

n5.title: The explorer
n5.body: Curious and adaptable, you grow through freedom, travel and new experiences.

n6.title: The nurturer
n6.body: Caring and responsible, you make homes and relationships feel safe.

n7.title: The seeker
n7.body: Thoughtful and intuitive, you look beneath the surface for deeper understanding.

n8.title: The achiever
n8.body: Ambitious and capable, you turn vision into results and use power with purpose.

n9.title: The humanitarian
n9.body: Compassionate and generous, you care about the bigger picture and about others.

n11.title: The intuitive (master number)
n11.body: A heightened sensitivity and vision; your challenge is to trust your inner voice while staying grounded.

n22.title: The master builder (master number)
n22.body: Big practical vision; you can turn ideals into real structures that serve many people.

n33.title: The master teacher (master number)
n33.body: Deep compassion and care; you uplift others through kindness, guidance and example.

tarotReading.title: Your card today
tarotReading.intro: One card from the full 78-card deck, drawn for you today. It stays the same all day.
tarotReading.note: A prompt for reflection, not a prediction.
tarotReading.artCredit: Card art: SoulMates Quest deck. Meanings based on A. E. Waite (1911).

three.title: Three-card reading
three.intro: Think of a question or a situation, then draw three cards: where you are, what is in the way, and what can help.
three.questionPlaceholder: For example: What do I need to see about this relationship?
three.sameNote: The same question gives the same cards for the rest of today.

library.title: The 78 cards
library.intro: Every card of the deck, with its upright and reversed meaning.

fool.name: The Fool
fool.meaning: A fresh beginning. Step forward with curiosity and an open heart, even if you cannot see the whole path yet.

magician.name: The Magician
magician.meaning: You have what you need. Focus your skills and attention, and turn an idea into action.

high_priestess.name: The High Priestess
high_priestess.meaning: Listen inward. Quiet intuition knows more than the noise around you today.

empress.name: The Empress
empress.meaning: Nurture and enjoy. Care for your body, your home and the people and projects you love.

emperor.name: The Emperor
emperor.meaning: Structure brings calm. Set clear boundaries and take steady responsibility.

hierophant.name: The Hierophant
hierophant.meaning: Learn from tradition and trusted guides. Shared values can show you the way.

lovers.name: The Lovers
lovers.meaning: A meaningful choice. Choose what truly aligns with your values, in love and in life.

chariot.name: The Chariot
chariot.meaning: Direction and willpower. Keep going towards your goal and steer your energy with intention.

strength.name: Strength
strength.meaning: Gentle courage. Patience and kindness are stronger than force today.

hermit.name: The Hermit
hermit.meaning: Time for reflection. Step back from the crowd and listen to your own inner light.

wheel_of_fortune.name: Wheel of Fortune
wheel_of_fortune.meaning: Things are moving. Stay open to change and notice the turning points.

justice.name: Justice
justice.meaning: Fairness and honesty. Weigh things clearly and own your choices.

hanged_man.name: The Hanged Man
hanged_man.meaning: Pause and see differently. Letting go of control can reveal a new perspective.

death.name: Death
death.meaning: An ending makes space. Something is changing form; release what has run its course.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.meaning: Balance and moderation. Blend opposites patiently and find the middle way.

devil.name: The Devil
devil.meaning: Notice what holds you. Habits or attachments may be ready to loosen.

tower.name: The Tower
tower.meaning: A sudden shift. What is not solid may fall, clearing the way for something truer.

star.name: The Star
star.meaning: Hope and renewal. Trust that healing is possible and keep your faith in the future.

moon.name: The Moon
moon.meaning: Not everything is clear yet. Move gently, trust your instincts and give feelings time.

sun.name: The Sun
sun.meaning: Warmth and joy. Let yourself be seen, celebrate small wins and share your light.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.meaning: A call to awaken. Reflect honestly and answer what you know is right for you.

world.name: The World
world.meaning: Completion and wholeness. Acknowledge how far you have come before the next chapter.
